concepts.description: A modular unit representing the AUV system architecture.
A physical or simulated robotic platform that interacts with sensors and actuators.
A defined boundary through which components of the AUV system communicate and exchange data or events.
A component within the AUV module responsible for managing and directing the behavior of the AUV system.
A basic data type defined within the AUV module representing fundamental value types.
A structured data type defined within the AUV module that groups multiple values together.
A data field within an Interface that holds a specific typed piece of information.
A signal or action defined within an Interface that can be triggered within the AUV system.
A computational operation defined within the AUV module that takes inputs and returns a result.

instances.description: The module representing the entire AUV system.
The robotic platform contained within the AUV_Module, using Sensors and Actuators interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to access sensor data.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Platform to control actuators.
A controller contained within AUV_Module that uses the Inputs interface to receive commands.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by AUV_Operator to receive input events.
A controller for the Last Response Engine contained within AUV_Module, using Inputs and Outputs interfaces.
An interface defined by AUV_Module used by LRE_Ctrl and AUV_Autopilot to send output events.
A controller contained within AUV_Module that uses the Outputs interface to send autopilot commands.
A primitive type representing natural numbers.
A primitive type representing integer numbers.
A primitive type representing string values.
A primitive type representing boolean values (true or false).
A primitive type representing real numbers.
A composite type representing a Spherical Vector, containing radial, polar, and azimuth values of type real.
A composite type representing an obstacle, containing ns_rel_dist, ew_rel_dist, depth, id (all of type real), and obs_hdng (of type SVec).
A value of type real within the Sensors interface representing the depth measurement.
A value of type SVec within the Sensors interface representing the heading measurement.
A value of type Obstacle within the Sensors interface representing detected obstacle data.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, signaling the end of a task.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an OCM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting a MOM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters and no return value, requesting an HCM operation.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current velocity.
An event in the Inputs interface with no parameters but with a return value of type real, requesting the current heading.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a velocity.
An event in the Outputs interface that takes one parameter of type real and has no return value, advising a heading.
A composite type representing a close distance record, containing horiz_cda and vert_cda (of type real) and id (of type nat).
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the horizontal distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
A function that takes an Obstacle as input and returns the vertical distance from the AUV to the Obstacle as a real number.
